Downy_Mildew.quote: When leaves are wet, or when humidity is very high, signs of Peronospora destructor are visible on the surface of older leaves as fine, furry, grayish-white growths.
In addition to leaves, the downy mildew pathogen can infect seed stalks and flower parts and can infect bulbs systemically.

Onion_Rust.quote: oval- to diamond-shaped, reddish- to dull-orange pustules that develop on leaf blades.
Lesions typically form first on older leaves, and then spread to younger leaves.
